messages.subject: cannot get same results
parts:
Dear Manuel,
I'm stuck by a problem. 
When I tuned for a benchmark problem, I used the best configuration from irace.  Irace shows me the mean best is about 1.96. However, I used this configuration in matlab to run 30 times. only one result was close to 1.96. The results of other 29 time were over 300. 
When I tuned other benchmark problems, The results was good. So This should't caused by my code. I also changed some parameters in scenario, but It was not work.


I wonder what  is the average of ？

I guess this problem may be caused by the random seed.  So what can coincide seed in irace with matlab？ Do you have any examples？

Best wishes,

Yanfei Qian

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: cannot get same results
parts:
Hi Yanfei,

As it says in the user guide page 28:

Mean best: Mean of the best configuration across the instances seen so far in this race.

My guess is that you are not changing the random seed within the target-runner when called from irace. As explained in the User Guide, irace passes an integer value (seed) to target-runner that should be used to initialize the random number generator. If you do not do that, the random number generator generates the same sequence of random numbers every time target-runner is called.

There is an example here: https://github.com/MLopez-Ibanez/irace/tree/master/inst/examples/matlab but you do not need to follow that example. Just initialize the RNG of matlab with the seed passed by irace to target-runner.

Best wishes,

Manuel.
